name: Clerk MCP Server
description: Add Clerk authentication to your app directly through Claude. Access up-to-date SDK snippets and implementation patterns for sign-in flows, session management, and route protection. Build multi-tenant B2B apps with organizations and role-based access, configure waitlists and early access flows, and implement billing. Get framework-specific examples for Next.js, React, Expo, and more through natural language prompts.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clerk MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clerk MCP Server to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.clerk.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Clerk MCP Server MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Clerk MCP Server scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Clerk MCP Server's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Clerk MCP Server scores 81/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 20 of 20 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clerk MCP Server MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clerk MCP Server provides these MCP tools: clerk_sdk_snippet and list_clerk_sdk_snippets.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clerk MCP Server?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clerk MCP Server in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.

_published_faq.name: Does Clerk MCP Server MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clerk MCP Server does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can Clerk MCP Server improve its MCP documentation?
